basic_details.job_title: NIH Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Deputy Secretary, Section Officer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Commission for Homoeopathy (NCH) has invited applications from Indian nationals for 8 posts to be filled on deputation: 3 Deputy Secretary, 1 Deputy Legal Adviser, 1 Under Secretary and 3 Section Officer. Applicants send their biodata in the prescribed proforma to Dr. Sanjay Gupta, Secretary, NCH, Janakpuri, New Delhi. Applications must be sent within 30 days from the date the advertisement is published in the Employment News.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall be not exceeding fifty-six years, as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 3 Deputy Secretary, 1 Deputy Legal Adviser, 1 Under Secretary and 3 Section Officer. All of them are filled by deputation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for NCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent within 30 days from the date the advertisement is published in the Employment News.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NCH Deputy Legal Adviser post?
faq.answer: The notice requires a bachelor's degree in law with eight years of experience of handling legal and legislative matters, or a Master's degree in law with five years of such experience. It lists this together with condition (a): an analogous post, or five years of regular service in Level 11 with experience of legal and legislative matters.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Deputy Secretary, Under Secretary and Section Officer posts?
faq.answer: Each of these posts asks for a bachelor's degree from a recognised university or institute and five years of experience in Accounts or administration or establishment work in a Government Office, Public Sector Undertaking or Statutory Body. Each also has its own condition (a): an analogous post, or regular service in the feeder level (five years in Level 11, six years in Level 8 or eight years in Level 7 respectively).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is not more than 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for NCH Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Deputy Secretary and Deputy Legal Adviser are at Level 12 (Rs.78800-209200/-). Under Secretary is at Level 11 (Rs.67700-208700/-), and Section Officer is at Level 08 (Rs.47600-151100/-).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for NCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send your biodata in the prescribed proforma from the NCH website, with an SOP of no more than 250 words, a passport photograph and copies of your qualification and experience certificates. The address is: Dr. Sanjay Gupta, Secretary, National Commission for Homoeopathy(NCH), No. 61-65, Institutional Area, Opp. D Block, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the deputation period at NCH?
faq.answer: The period of deputation shall ordinarily not exceed three years. This includes any deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment.

faq.question: Q9. Can feeder-category officers of NCH apply on deputation?
faq.answer: No. Department officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for appointment by deputation, and deputationists are not eligible for appointment by promotion.
